mentions.name: Pre-WWII radio repair
mentions.description: A hands-on restoration project: repairing a pre-WWII vacuum tube radio that uses a pentagrid converter. The radio's oscillator coil has crumbled to pieces, and its hot (unisolated) chassis complicates safe repair work, which an isolation transformer helps address.
mentions.problem: The radio's oscillator coil has deteriorated into green crumbles, and the set has a hot chassis that makes repair dangerous without an isolation transformer.
mentions.source_excerpt: Learning how to repair a pre-WWII  radio with a pentagrid converter. The oscillator coil became a tube of green crumbles.
